Record Class EnsembleSelection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
smile.feature.selection.EnsembleSelection
Record Components:
feature - The feature name.
importance - The variable importance score.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<EnsembleSelection>
public record EnsembleSelection(String feature, double importance) extends Record implements Comparable<EnsembleSelection>
Feature selection using tree ensemble models (such as Random Forest or Gradient Tree Boost).

Ensemble methods measure the importance of features by aggregating the impurity decrease (such as Gini impurity or variance reduction) across all trees in the ensemble. Features that appear frequently in splits yielding large impurity reductions achieve higher importance scores.
